forecasts.question: Will a named US or mediator (Oman/Qatar/Pakistan) official publicly confirm a scheduled follow-up Iran-US indirect session (with a stated date or venue) before EOD 2026-09-25?
forecasts.delta_reason: New 48h forecast. September 22 UNGA session described as 'promising, constructive' by Witkoff; Kushner present; Araghchi confirmed the meeting to IRIB. Witkoff said another session expected 'soon' but named no date or venue. Iran submitted written proposal Sep 16; Qatar and Pakistan active mediators. Against: 'soon' language is undated; Iran's conditions (lift blockade, release frozen assets, end Lebanon fighting) remain unmet; Trump's concurrent 'annihilate or deal' UNGA speech creates domestic pressure against rapid concessions. Resolution requires public confirmation of a date and venue, not mere intent. Net p=0.25.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-09-25, a named US official (Witkoff, Kushner, or senior State Department envoy), OR a named Omani/Qatari/Pakistani mediator official, OR the Iranian MFA publicly confirms a scheduled date and venue for a follow-up mediated Iran-US negotiating session. A statement that talks will continue 'soon,' 'in the coming days,' or 'when conditions allow' without naming a date or venue does NOT meet the threshold.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: One TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/Al Jazeera) citing the named official, OR an official government or mediator press statement carried by state media.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Expressions of intent to meet ('expects another meeting,' 'hopes to continue') without a confirmed date or venue = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. A social-media post from a named official stating a date and venue qualifies if confirmed by one TIER1 within 24 hours.

indicators.name: Witkoff or named US official publicly states date and venue for next session

forecasts.question: Will a formally convened Iran-US indirect negotiating session (mediated by a named third country, senior officials, named principals, not mere message relay) occur before EOD 2026-10-10?
forecasts.delta_reason: New 17-day forecast. Evidence for YES: September 22 UNGA session confirmed constructive by both sides; Witkoff explicitly stated 'another session expected soon'; Iran submitted formal written proposal September 16; Qatar and Pakistan both active mediators; diplomatic environment at its most active since the MoU collapsed in July. Evidence against: Iran's conditions (lift blockade, release frozen assets, end Lebanon fighting) remain unmet and are maximalist; last formally convened session with named principals was Islamabad April 11–12; Trump's concurrent 'annihilate or deal' UNGA framing creates incentives against rapid concessions; the September 22 UNGA exchange was shuttle diplomacy, not a jointly convened session. Near-coin-flip given the active diplomatic environment. p=0.48.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports a face-to-face or formally convened indirect session (not mere message relay) between named US and Iranian senior officials/envoys, hosted by a named mediator (Oman/Pakistan/Qatar/Switzerland), between 2026-09-24 and 2026-10-10. Named principals must appear on the US side (Witkoff, Kushner, or a named senior envoy) and the Iranian side (Araghchi, Ghalibaf, or a named SNSC/NSC official).
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1, OR one TIER1 plus an official mediator readout.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Message relay through intermediaries without a convened session (mediators shuttling between delegations in separate rooms without delegations meeting) = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Video conference qualifies only if explicitly described as a 'session' or 'meeting' by both sides. The September 22 UNGA session predates the forecast window and does NOT count.

forecasts.question: Will the US and Iran (or a named mediator on their joint behalf) publicly announce any interim operational arrangement for Strait of Hormuz commercial passage before EOD 2026-10-10?
forecasts.delta_reason: New 17-day forecast. Evidence for YES: Iran's September 22 UNGA offer to reopen Hormuz within 7 days if conditions met; Qatar and Pakistan active in Hormuz diplomacy; UNGA session described as positive by both sides. Evidence against: Iran's conditions (lift blockade, release frozen assets, end all fighting) are maximalist and remain unmet; Trump administration has not publicly accepted any component; AIS data shows strait at 10–15 vessels/day; even if Iran's conditions met immediately, 7-day reopening plus ramp to 30 vessels is beyond F4's Oct 3 window but potentially within this forecast's Oct 10 window. The bilateral confirmation requirement is a high bar; unilateral Iranian announcements do not resolve YES. p=0.18.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-10-10, a named mediator (Oman/Qatar/Pakistan) or TIER1 source reports that the US and Iran have jointly agreed to or acknowledged an interim operational arrangement for the Strait of Hormuz — including a named corridor, escort protocol, or time-limited non-interference commitment — confirmed by both the US side (named official) and the Iranian side (named official), or by a named mediator explicitly speaking on behalf of both parties.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: One TIER1 plus confirmation from both the US and Iranian sides, OR an official mediator readout explicitly attributing the arrangement to both parties.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Iranian unilateral announcement of 'conditions for reopening' without a US counter-commitment = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. A mediator announcement without explicit dual-side confirmation = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. The August 26 Iran-Oman bilateral route agreement does NOT count toward this forecast.

forecasts.question: Will commercial shipping through the Strait of Hormuz reach >=30 vessels/day (7-day rolling average) before EOD 2026-10-03?
forecasts.delta_reason: UPDATE (20-day gap). AIS-tracked transits fell to 7 vessels on Sep 9 (GlobalSecurity.org/RFE-RL, Sep 10), partially recovered to 14–17 vessels over Sep 20–21 weekend (The National, Sep 21). The 7-day rolling average is approximately 10–15 vessels/day — well under the 30-vessel threshold. Pre-war baseline was approximately 125 large commercial vessels/day. On Sep 22, Iran's UNGA delegation offered to reopen Hormuz within 7 days if the US lifts its naval blockade, releases frozen assets, and ends fighting on all fronts including Lebanon (Al Jazeera, New Arab, Sep 22). The US had not accepted any component as of EOD Sep 23. With 10 days remaining to Oct 3, even immediate US acceptance of Iran's conditions would require a 7-day reopening sequence plus rolling-average ramp to 30 vessels — geometrically infeasible in the remaining window. No P&I insurer has reinstated war-risk coverage. All three indicators remain NOT_OBSERVED. Reducing p from 0.22 to 0.05.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if any AIS-based ship-tracking source (IMF PortWatch, Straits.live, MarineTraffic, Lloyd's List Intelligence) records >=30 commercial transits/day as a 7-day rolling average at any point between 2026-09-03 and 2026-10-03.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: AIS-based tracker + one TIER1 or OSINT confirmation (Bloomberg/Reuters/Lloyd's List).
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Naval escort vessels and warships do not count toward commercial transit; if trackers diverge by >20%, flag AMBIGUOUS.

forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO. Horizon EOD 2026-09-06 passed. President Pezeshkian issued a conditional offer on Sep 1 ('Iran will return to MoU deal if US does the same') — ambiguity rule fires: conditional or preconditioned offers = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO, and the US did not accept the condition before Sep 6. FM Araghchi stated 'no decision yet' on Sep 3. Araghchi had rejected ceasefire formulations on Aug 19, demanding a 'complete and permanent end to the war' rather than a resumption of negotiations (Middle East Monitor). No TIER1 source records an unconditional public commitment by Araghchi, the SNSC, IRNA, or Tasnim to resuming mediated ceasefire negotiations before Sep 6 EOD. Resolution: NO.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-09-06, a named Iranian official (FM Araghchi, SNSC, or IRNA/Tasnim/Press TV quoting an official) issues a public statement committing to resuming or entering mediated ceasefire negotiations with the United States. forecasts.resolution_source_rule: One TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/Al Jazeera) citing the named Iranian official, OR Iranian state media (IRNA/Tasnim) carrying the official statement.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Conditional or preconditioned offers ('will talk if US stops strikes') = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO unless the US publicly accepts the condition; a mediator asserting Iran is 'open' without a named Iranian official statement = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.
